summary.description: One line, imperative, under 70 characters, for example: check the assignee for rule P4. It becomes the pull request title.

root_cause.description: One or two sentences: what was wrong and which documented rule it broke

files_changed.description: Repo-relative paths you changed or added, the regression test included. Empty when you made no change.

test_command.description: The command you ran for the full test suite

tests_passed.description: True only if the full suite passed after your change

risk.description: How likely the change breaks something else

notes.description: Anything a reviewer should know; if you made no change, why not
